en: Potential and act are concepts indispensable to any reflection on temporality. The pair taken together constitute, according to Aristotle, the origin and the guarantee of becoming. Though they reciprocally concern one another, they are two very distinct terms, irreducible to one another: for this reason, something that does not exist can still come into being, whereas something that exists could disappear; for this reason, things develop, mutate, come and go. If the potentially existing coincided with the actually existing, ‘no genesis or decay would be at all possible … and it would be a lie to speak of future things and past ones’.
zh: 潜能与实现是任何时间性反思都不可缺少的概念。亚里士多德认为，这一对概念合在一起构成生成变化的起源和保证。二者彼此相关，却又截然不同、不可相互还原：正因如此，不存在之物仍能生成，存在之物则可能消失；也正因如此，事物才会发展、变异、来去。如果潜在存在同现实存在重合，“任何生成或消灭都将完全不可能……谈论未来之物和过去之物也将成为谎言”。

en: Potential and act are the matrix of becoming because the relation between them, which is to say the difference between them, is already and as such a temporal relation (or difference). Potential is that which is not
actual (but can become so) whereas the actual is that which is
potential (but once was). This pair express the articulation of earlier and later, the preceding and the subsequent, the past and present. The two ways of being are defined as a
and an
, on the basis of the different positions that they occupy in

the flow of time. That said, the temporal position of each of these terms is established not by the clock or the calendar, but depends exclusively on the position of the other: they are correlated through their mutual opposition. Potential is potential in reference to a particular act, just as ‘earlier’ is ‘earlier’ than a particular ‘later’. Potential and act, when they are defined as a ‘before’ and ‘after’, are defining each other. We could not explain the act in isolation from the potential, for the same reasons that prevent us understanding ‘after’ without an implicit reference to ‘before’.
zh: 潜能与实现之所以是生成变化的基础，是因为二者之间的关系——也就是二者的差别——本身就已经是一种时间关系（或时间差别）。潜能是尚未成为现实、却能够成为现实的东西；现实则是不再只是潜在、却曾经是潜在的东西。这对概念表达了较早与较晚、在先与在后、过去与现在的分节。两种存在方式依照它们在时间流动中占据的不同位置，被界定为“之前”和“之后”。不过，每个概念的时间位置并不是由钟表或日历确定的，而完全取决于另一个概念的位置：二者通过相互对立而彼此关联。潜能总是相对于某个特定实现的潜能，正如“较早”总是相对于某个特定“较晚”而言较早。潜能与实现一旦被界定为“之前”与“之后”，便是在相互界定。我们无法脱离潜能解释实现，理由正如我们无法在不暗中指向“之前”的情况下理解“之后”。

en: No one can doubt the assertion that potential and act are temporal concepts – but it is also an equivocal statement. It immediately poses an alternative (a rather scholastic one, it is true, but no less unavoidable for that reason). Do potential and act fall

time, inscribed as an empirical ‘before’ and ‘after’ within its chronological progression? Or do they structure time and set its scansion, ordering time according to the dual axis of ‘before’ and ‘after’? Do they follow one after the other in the guise of ‘earlier’ and ‘later’, or do they reveal (and give shape to) the dimensions of earlier and later that define all sequences? Are they temporally articulated, or do they establish the articulation of which they appear to be subjects? In brief, are they
or do they
zh: 没有人会怀疑潜能与实现是时间概念；然而，这句话也含混不清。它立刻提出一个二选一的问题——诚然颇为经院哲学，却不会因此变得不必要。潜能与实现是落在时间之中，以经验性的“之前”与“之后”被铭写在时间的年代推进里？还是它们构造时间、设定时间的节奏，依照“之前”与“之后”的双轴安排时间？它们以“较早”与“较晚”的面貌前后相继，还是揭示并塑造了界定一切序列的较早和较晚这两个维度？它们是在时间中得到分节，还是建立了那个使它们看似成为被分节对象的分节？简言之：它们是被时间化，还是使时间化（temporalise）？

en: Nothing would be more mistaken than unilaterally to opt for one or the other of these two interpretations. Precisely because they are the presupposition for becoming, potential and act are not simply phenomena in becoming. On the other hand, because they also occupy a determinate position within the chronological sequence, nor are they mere vestiges of an ‘originary time’

extraneous to temporalised experience. The good reasons in support of one view, however numerous or incontrovertible they may be, do not cancel out the reasons for taking the other side. Perhaps what really matters, then, is this

itself. The evidence for an equivocal assertion of the temporal filigree of the concepts of potential and act is, ultimately, rather more convincing than any claim boasting of having specified any single meaning.
zh: 片面选择这两种解释中的任何一种，都再错误不过。潜能与实现恰恰因为是生成变化的预设，所以不只是生成变化中的现象。另一方面，它们又在年代序列中占据确定位置，因而也不只是某种外在于被时间化经验的‘本源时间’之印迹。支持一种观点的理由无论多么众多、多么无可争辩，都不能取消选择另一方的理由。那么，真正重要的或许正是这种含混本身。归根结底，承认潜能与实现这两个概念的时间纹理具有双重含义，比任何自称已经确定了唯一含义的主张都更令人信服。

en: Potential and act are temporalised just as much as they temporalise. They occupy a certain position in the unfolding of time, yet, on the other hand, they also determine what this position is. They have to do with both chronological
and temporal

. Yet it is not enough to note their amphibious nature. To aggregate their different aspects is, in itself, no more illuminating than the peremptory ultimatum that bifurcates and counterposes them. The decisive point lies, rather, in ascertaining what the nexus is between the specific manner in which potential and act fall
time, and the equally specific manner in which
determine time. Decisive, that is, in light of the following hypothesis: the pair in question are not only temporalised, nor only temporalising,

their peculiar content consists precisely in the juncture, or intersection, between the two. To put it another way: the relationship between potential and act is, first and foremost, a relationship between chronological
and temporal
, position and positioning, the empirical ‘before’ (or ‘after’) and the horizon of anteriority or posteriority. Within this relationship, therefore, it is necessary to focus on

children: the order of what is progressing and the progression of what is doing the ordering

en: , rather than on a certain progression and a certain order.
zh: 潜能与实现既被时间化，也使时间化。它们在时间展开中占据某个位置；但另一方面，它们也决定这个位置究竟是什么。它们既同年代推进有关，也同时间秩序有关。然而，仅仅指出它们具有这种两栖性质还不够。把它们的不同面向简单叠加起来，并不比那种把两者分开对立的强硬最后通牒更有启发。决定性问题反而在于查明：潜能与实现以其特有方式落入时间，同它们以同样特有的方式规定时间之间，存在什么联系。之所以具有决定性，是因为我们可以提出如下假说：这对概念既不只是被时间化，也不只是使时间化，原因正在于它们独特的内容就是二者的接合或交点。换句话说，潜能与实现之间的关系，首先是年代推进与时间秩序、位置与定位、经验性的“之前”（或“之后”）与在先性或在后性之视域之间的关系。因此，在这种关系内部，我们必须关注的是推进之物的秩序和安排秩序之物的推进，而不是某一种推进和某一种秩序。
弗朗茨·布伦塔诺，《论亚里士多德〈形而上学〉中存在的多重意义》（Sui molteplici significati dell’essere secondo Aristotele，1862），米兰，1995年，第58—59页。布伦塔诺在这里转述并解释亚里士多德《形而上学》第九卷，1047a 10—14。
